title: Golden Fez unmasks the complexities of desire and intimacy with “Selfish”
htmlContent:
Golden Fez's latest single, "Selfish," takes listeners on an emotional journey through the complex feelings of love and self protection. With a mix of heartfelt honesty similar to The Weeknd, the song explores the struggle of wanting someone while also wanting to keep your identity.

The music combines sleek sounds with a darker tone, creating the perfect backdrop for Golden Fez's smooth and expressive vocals. The lyrics reflect the push and pull of a passionate and hesitant relationship, where intense feelings are held back by the need to stay true to oneself. Golden Fez's vocal style is both heartfelt and confident, making it easy to connect with the feelings expressed.

https://open.spotify.com/track/7tAeT0xBf60n7VqSEtsn8o

The song's captivating beat and rich sound add to its emotional weight, immersing listeners in a space where being vulnerable and maintaining control can coexist. "Selfish" is a relatable song for anyone worried about giving too much in a relationship. Golden Fez sings about wanting, and they live it, making "Selfish" a captivating addition to their music collection.
